### Key Notes on the Text:

* **Abbreviations:**
* `filius` / `filia` = son / daughter.
* `Sponsore` / `Sponsoribus` / `Spons:` = Godparents/Sponsors.
* `Joannes Quinlan P.P. / C.C.` = The officiating parish priests (Parish Priest / Catholic Curate).


* **"In Exylio" / "In Exspectulo":** This note appears next to several entries marked *illegitimus*, a common historical phrasing used by clergy to denote births out of wedlock or outside the standard parish domicile bounds.
